2608.16316.title: Deep Thought Alignment: Trajectory-Level Latent Distillation for Video Reasoning
2608.16316.paper_summary: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) for video reasoning have long been hindered by the high computational cost of processing vast amounts of visual information. This dilemma motivates the transfer of the reasoning capabilities of large models to smaller, more efficient ones. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) offers a promising solution by matching output-token distributions along student-generated trajectories. However, video reasoning often depends on evidence accumulated across multiple frames. In this context, output-level supervision only captures information expressed through token predictions and does not directly constrain the latent representations formed during reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose Latent-OPD, which augments OPD with trajectory-level latent distillation. Specifically, our method focuses on the position at the end of each trajectory, where hidden states effectively summarize the accumulated visual evidence and reasoning context. Furthermore, we introduce a progressive teacher-lookahead strategy, which aligns middle-to-late student layers with increasingly deeper teacher layers. Experiments on six video reasoning benchmarks show that Latent-OPD consistently outperforms output-only OPD. Notably, the improvements are particularly pronounced in scenarios with limited frames, long videos, or tasks requiring complex evidence aggregation. These results establish Latent-OPD as a highly effective approach to frame-efficient video reasoning.
2608.16316.paper_summary_zh: 大型多模態模型（LMMs）在視頻推理方面長期受到處理大量視覺信息的高計算成本的限制。這一困境促使將大型模型的推理能力轉移到更小、更高效的模型上。政策內蒸餾（OPD）通過匹配沿著學生生成的軌跡的輸出標記分佈提供了一個有前景的解決方案。然而，視頻推理通常依賴於跨多幀積累的證據。在這種情況下，輸出級別的監督僅捕捉通過標記預測表達的信息，並未直接約束在推理過程中形成的潛在表示。為了解決這一限制，我們提出了潛在OPD，它通過軌跡級別的潛在蒸餾增強了OPD。具體而言，我們的方法專注於每條軌跡結束時的位置，在這裡隱藏狀態有效地總結了積累的視覺證據和推理上下文。此外，我們引入了一種漸進式教師前瞻策略，將中後期學生層與越來越深的教師層對齊。在六個視頻推理基準上的實驗顯示，潛在OPD始終優於僅輸出的OPD。值得注意的是，這些改進在幀數有限、視頻較長或需要複雜證據聚合的任務中尤為明顯。這些結果確立了潛在OPD作為一種高效的幀效率視頻推理方法。
